name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
summary: Hugging Face's router lets your app call hundreds of open models, served by partner providers, with one token and one bill.

free_plan_covers.note: Free accounts get $0.10 of Inference Providers credit each month (subject to change), enough to try it yourself but not to serve other people.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No monthly plan is needed for the API; past the free credit you buy credits and pay the providers' per-token rates with no Hugging Face markup. An optional PRO account raises the monthly credit to $2.

portability.note: Offers an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint at https://router.huggingface.co/v1 and serves open-weight models, so code can move with a base URL and key change.

free_tier.note: Every Hugging Face user gets monthly Inference Providers credits; free accounts get $0.10 a month.

sdk_typescript.note: Official JavaScript and TypeScript client is published as the "@huggingface/inference" npm package.

cheap_model_price.value: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct: $0.02 input / $0.05 output per million tokens (via DeepInfra)
cheap_model_price.note: Prices are the serving provider's rates passed through at cost and differ by provider; the router's model list shows each provider's current price.

setup.step: Create a fine-grained access token with the "Make calls to Inference Providers" permission in your token settings.
Set the token as an environment variable.
Install the SDK with npm install @huggingface/inference, or use the openai package with the base URL https://router.huggingface.co/v1.
Call chat completions from a server-side route handler, naming the model (for example openai/gpt-oss-120b).

builder_notes: Keep HF_TOKEN on the server only; never call the router from client-side code.
Append :cheapest to a model id to route to the lowest-priced provider, or :fastest for the highest throughput.
The free credit is only $0.10 a month; buy credits before launch so requests keep working.
